title: Personal Injury Attorneys & Medical Professionals Mixer
summary: An evening built around cigars, organic connections, and relaxed conversation for attorneys, medical providers, sponsors, and community partners.
description: The April mixer traded the usual restaurant patio for a cigar lounge, and the pace of the room changed with it. Conversations ran longer and fewer people left at the first natural exit point.
It's now a fixture on the calendar. We'll be back in this format at least twice a year.

flyer.alt: Personal Injury Attorneys and Medical Professionals Mixer flyer, April 30 2026, Plantation

recap.headline: Slower room, longer conversations.
body: Something about a cigar lounge makes people stop checking their phones. Ninety-one attendees and the room was still two-thirds full at 9:00, which almost never happens at a restaurant venue.
Sponsor recognition ran short on purpose. The point of the evening was the conversation, and it didn't need help.

photos.alt: Two attendees deep in conversation at the April mixer
photos.caption: The kind of conversation the format was built for.

comments.author: Hannah Goldstein
comments.body: Best format MMG has run. Please do this one again — a lounge beats a loud restaurant every time when you're trying to actually talk to someone.

comments.author: Darnell Pierce
comments.body: Agreed. Also appreciated that the program was five minutes instead of thirty.
